name: focused-measurement-delivery
goal: Preserve original page runtime measurements and screenshots across identical-tree delivery without granting a full verification verdict.

evidence: Current page delivery shows missing runtime figures after a source-identical squash. entityShown only accepts a green point whose commit exactly equals the selected commit, unlike focused screenshot selection. Original green measurements exist and their provenance must remain unchanged.

The standard entity-shown summary test covered record figures but not focused observations or the original, identical prepared tree, identical projected tree, changed tree and unknown tree lifecycle. Extend that existing matrix with an explicit no-full-verdict and original-provenance assertion. No one-off test file is needed.
